decision_question: Does the post contract distinguish standalone posts from replies while resolving identity, claims, and links only at execution time?

source_evidence.source: Synthetic workflow fixture reviewed at execution time
source_evidence.observation: A supplied parent URL identified an existing conversation rather than a new-post destination.

source_evidence.source: Synthetic workflow fixture reviewed at execution time
source_evidence.observation: Public copy needed singular human ownership and a distinction between aspirational language and an official result.

source_evidence.authority: public source supplied at execution time
source_evidence.observation: A canonical public link was retained for the call to action without being embedded in the package.

hypothesis: A standalone-post routing rule and visible claim stance will prevent wrong-surface drafting and unsupported outcome claims.
changes: Route supplied parent URLs to the comment skill.
Add runtime campaign brief, authorship, AI-role, aspirational-claim, shipped-versus-planned, and canonical-link rules.
Keep examples and evaluation fixtures free of identity, account, project, and topic details.
Expand the output contract and add development regression cases.
rejected_alternatives: Did not add publication or audience-setting behavior.
Did not duplicate the comment workflow inside the post skill.
Did not persist a real destination or URL.
regression_risks: A supplied URL may be a reference rather than a parent conversation; inspect the target before routing.
Claim stance is conditional and should not clutter ordinary updates.
evaluation_limitations: No isolated with-skill/without-skill executor was available.
No unseen release holdout was run; this record is analytical only.
